profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Over 15 years at work,  learning new systems/technologies, designing, creating and improvising software solutions. I  have good experience working in dynamic and multicultural environments and coordinating with different teams for achieving the project goals . 
My skill set includes software programming , Unix shell scripting, Linux internals, middleware development, system administration, data acquisition, data integration, cloud automation ,and project management.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Project: Personal Video Recorder
Description:
PVR (Personal video recorder) is used for recording of the broadcasted content and playback of the same. As part of recording f eature, PVR supports series recording, split recording, trailer booking, recommendations etc. Programs can be triggered for recording using EPG scheduling, One Touch and Manual recording modes. PVR consists of a conflict management module to detect conflicts between different schedule/active recordings and prompts user for action. On the playback side, PVR supports normal playback, trick modes, skip forward/backward and bookmarks management. Other key features include chase playback and live pause. PVR component is integrated with DVB-T broadcasted stack and pre-compliance tested with Freeview+ and Evora test suites .

Responsibilities/Contributions: Design, Development and unit testing of the following playback related features in PVR
-Playback of partial TS file using demux, audio/video decoder abstractions from HAL. 
-Circular buffer management for feeding TS d a t a into hardware demux. -Trick modes using index data stored during recording. 
-Skip forward/backward. 
-Bookmark management and skip to bookmark 
-Selection of different components during playback
(audio, subtitle in different languages etc) 
-Unit Testing of playback features with recorded live streams, Freeview + and Evora streams.

positions.title: Lead Engineer
positions.description:
Project: Trinetra

Description:
Trinetra-Sajeev Project dealt with the development of the user interface for camcorder. The user interface could interact with the camcorder middleware. The User interface consisted of hardware keys, rings and touch panel. The touch panel software consisted of views, passive widgets and active widgets. Active widgets could change dynamically. Views were developed using active and passive widgets. Menu view opened other independent views. The independent views were developed to monitor /change various camera parameters as well as to display live/recorded video/pictures.

Responsibility:
Software Design and development, Unit Testing, Maintenance, Code review. 

Contributions:
Development of views/widgets using proprietary tools and programming the communication with the middleware using C++

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Project : MQNsure
Description:
MQ-Nsure is a centralized suite-based Service Fulfillment offering that facilitates seamless integration of various network elements and performs multiple Network operations simultaneously. It is a complete end-to-end solution addressing the operator challenges and also ensuring growth amidst Technology changes. It enables Service Providers to expand their Service Delivery Platform by overcoming any network limitations that are currently prevailing in their existing setups as well as by making possible differentiator service offerings by moving more towards subscriber -managed services. The service fulfillment suite includes: a)Flexible, Advanced and Robust AAA b)DHCP c)Policy
Management d)Captive portal 

Responsibility:
Software Design and development, Unit Testing, Maintenance .

Contributions:
 1)Development of proprietary TFTP server. Tftp server is used for retrieving the file mentioned by the DHCP server. RFC 1350 was used during development.
 2)Development of DOCSIS compliant DHCP server. The DHCP server is used to retrieve the IP address, configuration filename and other information. RFCs 2131, 2132 were used during the development .Various DHCP options were implemented to support DOCSIS.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Project: Remote Equipment Parameter Management (REPMAN)
Responsibilities/Contributions:
Software Design and development, Unit Testing, Maintenance for the following features:
1) SMS data acquisition: Used for retrieving the data sent by the hardware device;
2)Database backend : to maintain the data.
3) udp data acquisition : Used for retrieving the data sent by the hardware device (mandatory in Live
mode ).
4)SMS Server: for sending service commands to the hardware device and retrieve data from the hardware
device.
5)Web-based test interface for testing : This testing interface was developed in python

Project: Time and Access Management:
Responsibilities:
Software Design and development, Unit Testing, Maintenance .
Contibutions:
1) Design and development of the module responsible for automatic data acquisition from the hardware device that had the Time and access details
2) Design and development the database backend.
3) Design and development of basic testing webpage developed in python.
